types.comment: Speaking audio character (ACharacter(char *)), derived from ABaseSound (0xc0; PS2 0xb0 with its vptr last at +0xac, reused by ACharacter). Size 0xd0 from deleting dtor 1c110 / GetACharacter alloc 0xd0; +0xc4..+0xcf presumably alignment padding (ABaseSound is 16-byte aligned). Ctor overrides minDistance 3.0, maxDistance 25.0, maxDistanceSq 625.0 (Xbox +0x6c/70/74 = PS2 +0x5c/60/64).

fields.name: poser
fields.comment: high: GetCurrentFrame 11020 = [[+0x14]+8] (ActPoser.currentFrame); GetRemainingTime 11060 = totalFrames(+0x18)*secondsPerFrame(+0x2c) - secondsPerFrame*currentFrame; PS2 accessors and GetActPoser read +0x4 (ctor a2 = ActPoser *), pointee offsets +4 o

types.comment: Animation controller wrapping an ActPoser (PS2 ctor(ActAnimGroup *, ActPoser *, ?)). Xbox vtable 2 slots (restored by ~AnimationController 12610; its ctors are inlined into subclasses, no other xref to the vtable). Size low confidence: PS2 base is 0x18 (vptr last at +0x14) and Xbox needs at least 0x18. The 48/64-byte allocations under its tag are presumably subclasses. The Xbox member order differs from PS2 (poser at +0x14, PS2 +0x4); the other members are not located on Xbox.
